name: trim_intermediate_plots
title: Drop plots that the next plot contains

origin.description: Drop a recorded plot when its display list is a prefix of the next plot.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: An evaluation that may contain successive plots.

origin.details: plot() records the whole page. text() and lines() append to that display list, so the earlier plot is contained in the later one and is dropped.
origin.value: The evaluation with those intermediate plots removed.
